Learn how to epoxy a garage floor AGAIN! My original epoxy floor I got done 2yrs ago was yellowing and was not providing the durability I was promised. My friend​⁠ @therealtavarish saw this when he visited and told me to use a specific brand of epoxy (@simironcoatings) that worked for his shops so I got my floors redone and here is the process. It’s nice to have my garage epoxied and actually be durable! The company that did the coating is @luxefloorcoatings_ . This is not sponsored and I paid him but he did a great job so he gets a shout out for that!

THIS 76 YEAR-OLD LAND ROVER STILL FULLY RUNS?

Are you familiar with the very first variant Land Rover ever made? The 1950 Land Rover Series 1!

It was first imported into Singapore by Champion Motors, and then it travelled all the way to Perak, where it eventually got sold for scraps. In 2019, Jerome brought it back into Singapore and did a full restoration!

The Gran Turismo World Series is the premier global championship for Gran Turismo 7, bringing together the world’s best virtual racers to compete for their country and favourite car manufacturers. Singapore was selected as the Southeast Asian host city for Round 3, showcasing the region’s growing passion for motorsport and gaming. 🏁🎮

After two exhilarating races, two deserving winners were crowned. Daniel Solis of Team Subaru took home the Manufacturers Cup, while Japan’s Takuma Miyazono emerged victorious in the Nations Cup.🏆
